---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138365183/643852936/-2030239706?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFlZGI2M2FlLTNiYTYtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TR0MourmPZMkw1e2sLAX6tekdcu6np5wtjjtC1npNBs=&emci=bb87ad9b-0ea6-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&emdi=aedb63ae-3ba6-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&ceid=33603084)
---
| | | Team,Postmaster General David Steiner is trying to turn the United States Postal Service into a tool for Trump’s voter suppression scheme.

Under the direction of Steiner, the USPS has finalized a rule based on Trump’s executive order attacking vote by mail that would block election ballots from being delivered to anyone not on a “verified citizenship” list created in part by the Department of Homeland Security. Voting by mail is safe, secure, and easy. This is nothing more than the next play to fan the flames under a false flag of election security. Even the judge who lifted her nationwide injunction after the Supreme Court order lifted another injunction the same week said perhaps the goal of the Trump administration was to sow chaos before the 2026 election. Let’s be clear, they know no credible investigation has ever found widespread voter fraud or illegal voting, but this has never been about election security like the Trump administration claims. **[Tell the Board of Governors: Don’t help Trump’s illegal voter suppression scheme. Reverse the plan to block mail-in ballots immediately.>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138365184/643852937/863344481?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFlZGI2M2FlLTNiYTYtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TR0MourmPZMkw1e2sLAX6tekdcu6np5wtjjtC1npNBs=&emci=bb87ad9b-0ea6-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&emdi=aedb63ae-3ba6-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&ceid=33603084)**
---
[ **START WRITING NOW ⇨** ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138365185/643852938/863344481?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFlZGI2M2FlLTNiYTYtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TR0MourmPZMkw1e2sLAX6tekdcu6np5wtjjtC1npNBs=&emci=bb87ad9b-0ea6-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&emdi=aedb63ae-3ba6-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&ceid=33603084)
---
Election officials in Texas and Missouri have already found that DHS’s databases are inaccurate and flawed, repeatedly misidentifying people, setting up a system that could block millions of mail-in ballots across the country. That’s right, in Boone County, Missouri, more than half of the voters initially flagged as ineligible turned out to be eligible and Texas election officials have uncovered errors across dozens of counties. This is just an attempt to use the USPS as a tool to implement a massive voter suppression campaign. That’s why Postmaster General Steiner told Congress in June point-blank that USPS would not deliver any ballot mail in states that refused to provide the voter-level data and verified citizen lists demanded under his proposed rule.

After a Supreme Court decision added new chaos to the ongoing litigation, including on-again off-again injunctions and restraining orders, currently Steiner’s USPS is blocked from moving forward with its plan to implement Trump’s voter suppression scheme – for now. All of this legal uncertainty so close to the 2026 midterm election just strengthens the need for the Board of Governors to act.

clean_body: They need to reverse the plan to block mail-in ballots immediately. | | | | | | Team,Postmaster General David Steiner is trying to turn the United States Postal Service into a tool for Trump’s voter suppression scheme. Under the direction of Steiner, the USPS has finalized a rule based on Trump’s executive order attacking vote by mail that would block election ballots from being delivered to anyone not on a “verified citizenship” list created in part by the Department of Homeland Security. Voting by mail is safe, secure, and easy. This is nothing more than the next play to fan the flames under a false flag of election security. Even the judge who lifted her nationwide injunction after the Supreme Court order lifted another injunction the same week said perhaps the goal of the Trump administration was to sow chaos before the 2026 election. Let’s be clear, they know no credible investigation has ever found widespread voter fraud or illegal voting, but this has never been about election security like the Trump administration claims. Election officials in Texas and Missouri have already found that DHS’s databases are inaccurate and flawed, repeatedly misidentifying people, setting up a system that could block millions of mail-in ballots across the country. That’s right, in Boone County, Missouri, more than half of the voters initially flagged as ineligible turned out to be eligible and Texas election officials have uncovered errors across dozens of counties. This is just an attempt to use the USPS as a tool to implement a massive voter suppression campaign. That’s why Postmaster General Steiner told Congress in June point-blank that USPS would not deliver any ballot mail in states that refused to provide the voter-level data and verified citizen lists demanded under his proposed rule. After a Supreme Court decision added new chaos to the ongoing litigation, including on-again off-again injunctions and restraining orders, currently Steiner’s USPS is blocked from moving forward with its plan to implement Trump’s voter suppression scheme – for now. All of this legal uncertainty so close to the 2026 midterm election just strengthens the need for the Board of Governors to act. | | | I'll be direct: we missed our August online fundraising goal.

**That’s a serious problem because our race was recently moved from Lean Democrat to Toss-Up.**

Ours is one of the most competitive House races in the country. National Republicans are pouring money into our district. **Even House Speaker Mike Johnson came to our district to fundraise for my opponent. **

body:
Different rooms, same energy

Hey Friend, it's Scott Brown with a story to share.

Music has always been part of my life.

Whether I'm on stage with my band or just running through a set in my head between stops, it's how I clear my mind, how I recharge, and how I get ready for whatever the next day on the trail brings.

Last week I spent the day out talking with voters, then closed the night out on stage with my band, guitar in hand, giving it everything I had. Different rooms, same energy. That's just who I am.

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Any day now, students are arriving on campus and the Abortion Lobby's lackeys are waiting to ambush them with lies.

Lies about "safe sex."

Lies about "_if it feels good, do it. " _

And - finally and most devastatingly - lies about the _" clump of cells" _that result from this lifestyle and for which they provide only one "solution:" **__abortion__**** _._**

The Abortion Lobby's business model relies on a fresh supply of college students to feed their abortion assembly-line.

**That 's why nearly 90% of Planned Parenthoods are located within walking distance of a college campus!**

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5fdbc06f05214b3581011778de563ec9&_e=mEqIEC4tQkT_S0GpI2UR6dNbLYEOHVYhI3_x24xkERDrGbv5f-R-9qGEhpT9WrwJqPm5EoV7o21PlUO3xU_WX7KvwUdaiPR5TMY5ZWzwgRp1an3KYka30c38a7VD-ZlG3idOzM-skPFcUuzlbKHIV90Jz57oU8rwkko268TXjlPttf20MSnBxiI035b8NYxfhykP3gf9D1YkgZ8-T1h_1zbqXvq60tGw0Fc1emdVHjRvPfsKl9z3tQ65XahQcdTHDenss3K78hhBn86nSwMZhFTfj0vV8Ry7wm7D_334qfHlQyC_py5akhEeWV_98bAG4aJz8hXmkJgdcmelerQSVg_7TJZ4mH8Nu24d-yTqxGh1Vdt-xTSEjIRzs9yUvuKhQzP55mM8OMkuqTbG6sKWRmelPx3-oPM3_Dlj2Rk5r5s4_U1ZyOCPB3tm_fFI3KwDNsBiHUlsINBW9rWu5Dv-0eaNQv_f6YR1XqTgGmlGkRocZ_zuNPhyNgpo_G-6Ygj97IC4ofFDjAQ1dXoEq1UinFhKeuLf87g4RmaIx-LWB4IFcWFxkEe9k2cWxlSSZadl0Vgx8W1DbTwXkUAw8jAJsf-lLxuqpn6imqcKExTL-EoGPM_09KYkltzND6Ukg7P5)

To expose the true impact of the Abortion Goliath, many of our college groups will place 1,190 bright pink crosses right smack in the middle of campus as a _Cemetery of the Innocents_ display to serve as a stark reminder of the reality that abortion kills preborn babies.

Pro-Life Friend, I've always thought of _Students for Life_ as your organization. That's why I want you to be part of our witness.

[So would you please agree to sponsor a cross today with a tax-deductible gift of $10](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5fdbc06f05214b3581011778de563ec9&_e=mEqIEC4tQkT_S0GpI2UR6dNbLYEOHVYhI3_x24xkERDrGbv5f-R-9qGEhpT9WrwJqPm5EoV7o21PlUO3xU_WX7KvwUdaiPR5TMY5ZWzwgRp1an3KYka30c38a7VD-ZlG3idOzM-skPFcUuzlbKHIV90Jz57oU8rwkko268TXjlPly7G-UYMsZwTYuBh5vwQYykJ_ZxLsfutoDHuO2oJXPfhB1p_16AOfMW3KPLidGtZdqd3Lk8_zRgXdoXxDNFg9biZ180D4Vmgs1tqyk92zi8VVwC1WqJZwenooWcYVswveO49idwo1zAVvJaqkwwF-aDSqYm8lpu-Z80NcK9IZwFBVyCa1nINgkH61-GrryX7J-M3bjTnEVS6N0QI8xGDfX7Iy5_99aTx5MQuQqSOTd4O-zZCPt_vjqWxuP4EeNgaotuOmHao1bYyD5v7HWeLql7iVtQFUDgnSSdxexCo2iaqRPly8ugrnGu18bFh6HO3dtzfBIf0oA1_O22PP1tRQC-FsFnRtiifec3pRALqDTeWcImY367P8jPX2cedHc04XDL5Y0o77Qln9Z9sNMgzIBg8rSb_paB3601P9tAYbl4VcTJ0wTGAJZ75BqCcaHTVabA_7sgpA6bOah8fW3ui0)**?**

Your sponsorship will provide a voice for the voiceless right where it needs to be heard most - on American college campuses.

Planned Parenthood sets traps for young college girls as they walk on campus - traps that end in pain, regret ... and the bloodshed of hundreds of thousands of preborn babies every year.

**Planned Parenthood admitted to committing 434,350 abortions in their latest annual report.**

**That 's 1,190 precious little lives snuffed out every day. **

That's the significance of the 1,190 pink crosses that [I’m asking you to sponsor today](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5fdbc06f05214b3581011778de563ec9&_e=mEqIEC4tQkT_S0GpI2UR6dNbLYEOHVYhI3_x24xkERDrGbv5f-R-9qGEhpT9WrwJqPm5EoV7o21PlUO3xU_WX7KvwUdaiPR5TMY5ZWzwgRp1an3KYka30c38a7VD-ZlG3idOzM-skPFcUuzlbKHIV90Jz57oU8rwkko268TXjlMBzSXP_-Y9VSLqQELKnd8q3Vb4K-XbTqxhsjdVmjfdYRy3BWxw96jhTKdyw-MKMXeADW38so4P_lpQbKjjQxGkzETHG0FnaheAxP3ZCWEoLgXZfM_PCUWbmeeY3oZcI5nH39zbBzwftF0qK_2mUcB0Jj162Pb865O5sv3WeTAC3kyhAoH7ujFBYe-8JdxIQHnHL-zY5_T1PiON5QiQJ-OVoXEg85olj2VxhQaFjRy22eEEZy0ebDnKTIaBjqPsojuR1lEDqYJfXojwhLzXXZwOX4UfbPUOeIDPn4EtmjCEbYkOSWodjljdIUVY6ZF1SDF8bZjdTmSzq2WCEsW_sEEPUVWoP4KWrCoHSSfHVbz7Duq7qUS7lG6y1SI4sJ2Aoj2ZLd4XzWPpLlOy0NnTLhKd8Kxs7kXBrfZTMjttuqECKGz_YbZ10W4lGhzFWRem6j6imEeGctsgbBN5E2BpFF9z)**.**

But we're only able to do pro-life awareness events like this because of the support of good folks like you.

You see, thanks to our supporters, _Students for Life_ has conducted one of the largest youth outreach efforts in American history over the past year as we've:

● Built a network of 1,700+ active campus pro-life groups and now have a presence on 57% of all four-year public colleges nationwide;

● Activated 22,085+ pro-life student leaders;

● Visited 1,130 college campuses across the nation;

● Held 1,189 trainings;

● Started 160 new campus groups; and

● Garnered over 231,400,000 views of our online videos.

**With two decades of experience under our belts, no one is better at talking to young people about abortion than we are.**

Just by telling young people the TRUTH about abortion, we've found we can convert up to 19% of the pro-abortion/on-the-fence young people we talk to right on the spot.

And our work is starting to show real results as:

Recently, _Gallup_ reported that since the fall of _Roe:_

**•** The percentage of young adults (ages 18-29) identifying as pro-life rose by **11 points;** and

**•** The percentage of young adults who believed abortion should be legal in all circumstances **dropped by 14 points!**

That's not by accident.

Our _Cemetery of the Innocents_ display is an instant mind-changer for anyone who sees it. So, I want to bring it to as many campuses as possible this fall.

Of course, pro-abortion radicals know that too.

That's why they often stomp on, tear down, and throw this display in the trash.

That's where you come in, Pro-Life Friend.

The world needs to see the cold reality of what Planned Parenthood really is: **a killing factory.**

And we need to get as many college campuses as possible on board to display these pink crosses.

Because I know seeing all of these tiny pink crosses might help a young woman to stop and reconsider before ending the life of her preborn baby.

It may touch the heart of a Planned Parenthood employee and help them turn away from abortion.

Or, it could create the movement that may finally convince Congress to step up and DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD of all our taxpayer dollars.

clean_body: Dear Pro-Life Friend, Any day now, students are arriving on campus and the Abortion Lobby's lackeys are waiting to ambush them with lies. Lies about "safe sex." Lies about "if it feels good, do it. " And - finally and most devastatingly - lies about the " clump of cells" that result from this lifestyle and for which they provide only one "solution:" abortion . The Abortion Lobby's business model relies on a fresh supply of college students to feed their abortion assembly-line. That 's why nearly 90% of Planned Parenthoods are located within walking distance of a college campus! To expose the true impact of the Abortion Goliath, many of our college groups will place 1,190 bright pink crosses right smack in the middle of campus as a Cemetery of the Innocents display to serve as a stark reminder of the reality that abortion kills preborn babies. Pro-Life Friend, I've always thought of Students for Life as your organization. That's why I want you to be part of our witness. ? Your sponsorship will provide a voice for the voiceless right where it needs to be heard most - on American college campuses. Planned Parenthood sets traps for young college girls as they walk on campus - traps that end in pain, regret ... and the bloodshed of hundreds of thousands of preborn babies every year. Planned Parenthood admitted to committing 434,350 abortions in their latest annual report. That 's 1,190 precious little lives snuffed out every day. That's the significance of the 1,190 pink crosses that . But we're only able to do pro-life awareness events like this because of the support of good folks like you. You see, thanks to our supporters, Students for Life has conducted one of the largest youth outreach efforts in American history over the past year as we've: ● Built a network of 1,700+ active campus pro-life groups and now have a presence on 57% of all four-year public colleges nationwide; ● Activated 22,085+ pro-life student leaders; ● Visited 1,130 college campuses across the nation; ● Held 1,189 trainings; ● Started 160 new campus groups; and ● Garnered over 231,400,000 views of our online videos. With two decades of experience under our belts, no one is better at talking to young people about abortion than we are. Just by telling young people the TRUTH about abortion, we've found we can convert up to 19% of the pro-abortion/on-the-fence young people we talk to right on the spot. And our work is starting to show real results as: Recently, Gallup reported that since the fall of Roe: • The percentage of young adults (ages 18-29) identifying as pro-life rose by 11 points; and • The percentage of young adults who believed abortion should be legal in all circumstances dropped by 14 points! That's not by accident. Our Cemetery of the Innocents display is an instant mind-changer for anyone who sees it. So, I want to bring it to as many campuses as possible this fall. Of course, pro-abortion radicals know that too. That's why they often stomp on, tear down, and throw this display in the trash. That's where you come in, Pro-Life Friend. ? The world needs to see the cold reality of what Planned Parenthood really is: a killing factory. And we need to get as many college campuses as possible on board to display these pink crosses. Because I know seeing all of these tiny pink crosses might help a young woman to stop and reconsider before ending the life of her preborn baby. It may touch the heart of a Planned Parenthood employee and help them turn away from abortion. Or, it could create the movement that may finally convince Congress to step up and DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD of all our taxpayer dollars. I'd like to share another op ed that wasn't published, but before I do, will you RSVP to tomorrow's Blount County Town Hall? Then, will you forward this email to the folks in your network who have hard questions Tim Burchett has failed to answer? I'm ready to answer our neighbors' toughest questions.
---
[ BLOUNT TOWN HALL RSVP ](https://clicksp.michaelafortennessee.com/f/a/mJO42I8TeygpTJomBlgJGA~~/AAPPABA~/JGLNiSUHM0XsQUhivbSbtBA2IWtm4tbmRekzhGteiw29pGM2J4K70xX0BGI64eameDIwjhEcI4Bzc-OCqxqHmhNA7k8qxyn5JA5GoJo630lgpMoJvse2NH7He-j9wq0MYoqu6Hfm8ILuJ_rZFV88L6oYb4OmvQe-TEK2iCfkQSYIfAW1br5Ha7WuIKpkWc3AMuM3ZebILIz4aU8KiwYOEVB33bYh1qx8tCdNEzqgMDYh_m5z1ViJloyXIhQvovNBOItqvfOvuQHFTz_XuXKGCxcFULgxIUdGOM4Cj_v_f70~)

The people of East Tennessee deserve representatives who will prioritize their needs - not corporate or foreign interests, not party leadership, not whoever is in the White House. In a recent email, Representative Tim Burchett wrote that he didn't go to Washington "to get invited to fancy dinners, slap backs with lobbyists, or become another polished-up swamp creature who knows exactly when to smile and keep his mouth shut." He then suggests that if I win, the folks in Washington "could finally get somebody who doesn't ask so many uncomfortable questions." I grew up on a horse farm and mucked out stalls before school. So when Tim says that he can "smell a load of manure before Washington finishes putting a bow on it," I can too. I actually have no problem asking uncomfortable questions. And I have some for Tim. _Our cattle farmers in East Tennessee are struggling.**Why haven 't you spoken out against President Trump's plan to import 300,000 tons of foreign ground beef? **_ _You claim to be a stalwart fiscal conservative who cares about lowering our national debt.**Why did you vote to increase it by over $3 trillion dollars in the next ten years alone? **_ _East Tennesseans are struggling with expensive, inaccessible healthcare.**Why did you vote to take away healthcare from 29,000 of your own constituents? **_ _East Tennessee is the epicenter of our nation 's housing crisis. **Why did you vote against a bipartisan housing bill that will help bring down housing costs? **_ _You 've been outspoken about the horrors in the Epstein files and the need for justice for victims and decisive accountability for the abusers revealed within them, no matter how much power they hold. _ _Why then did you back off when you learned that Trump was in them? Why did you not join the discharge petition that would force a floor vote? Realizing that choice was unpopular, why did you request unanimous consent?**Was it so that no Republicans would have to vote on the record to release the files and anger Trump? **_ _You speak frequently about fighting the swamp, and your inability to get anything done in Congress as a result.**With Republicans holding the House, the Senate, the White House, and conservatives controlling the Supreme Court, who exactly makes up the "swamp"?**_ _You support three terms for members of Congress._**_Why are you running for your fifth? _** _You 've had seven years in Congress. **Why has one of your bills never become law? **_ _You say that you went to Washington to represent folks who work hard.**Why won 't you hold a town hall so your hard-working constituents can ask ****you some uncomfortable questions? **_ Unlike my opponent, I'm not afraid of my constituents or hard questions. That's why I have hosted Town Halls throughout my campaign, and why we have three Town Halls on the calendar between now and the start of early voting. **Tomorrow night on Wednesday, September 2, we're hosting the first of three Town Halls at the Blount County Public Library. **

You claim to be a stalwart fiscal conservative who cares about lowering our national debt.Why did you vote to increase it by over $3 trillion dollars in the next ten years alone? East Tennesseans are struggling with expensive, inaccessible healthcare.Why did you vote to take away healthcare from 29,000 of your own constituents? East Tennessee is the epicenter of our nation 's housing crisis. Why did you vote against a bipartisan housing bill that will help bring down housing costs? You 've been outspoken about the horrors in the Epstein files and the need for justice for victims and decisive accountability for the abusers revealed within them, no matter how much power they hold. Why then did you back off when you learned that Trump was in them? Why did you not join the discharge petition that would force a floor vote? Realizing that choice was unpopular, why did you request unanimous consent?Was it so that no Republicans would have to vote on the record to release the files and anger Trump? You speak frequently about fighting the swamp, and your inability to get anything done in Congress as a result.With Republicans holding the House, the Senate, the White House, and conservatives controlling the Supreme Court, who exactly makes up the "swamp"? You support three terms for members of Congress.Why are you running for your fifth? You 've had seven years in Congress. Why has one of your bills never become law? You say that you went to Washington to represent folks who work hard.Why won 't you hold a town hall so your hard-working constituents can ask you some uncomfortable questions? Unlike my opponent, I'm not afraid of my constituents or hard questions. That's why I have hosted Town Halls throughout my campaign, and why we have three Town Halls on the calendar between now and the start of early voting. Tomorrow night on Wednesday, September 2, we're hosting the first of three Town Halls at the Blount County Public Library. ~ Bookmark our upcoming Town Halls: Tuesday, September 15 from 6 - 7:30 pm ~ Wednesday, October 7 from 6 - 7:30 pm ~ | ~~ "Facebook" ~ "Instagram" ~~ "TikTok" ~ "Bluesky" ~ "Reddit" Please address checks payable to: Michaela for Tennessee PO Box 9116 Knoxville, TN 37940 Paid for by Michaela for Tennessee ~~ "Website"

The message couldn't be clearer: **AI isn 't a bubble. It's the new economy.**1
**The Problem No One Talks About:**
Data centers and AI supercomputers run 24/7, devouring electricity.
But **lithium batteries can 't keep up**.1 They're too expensive, supplies are tight, and**China controls more than 70% of global lithium processing.**
If AI is going to scale to trillions of dollars, the real constraint isn't chips...
It's power storage.1

Think about it: NVIDIA builds the chips.
Oracle runs the cloud. But without safer, cheaper, U.S.-made batteries, the AI boom hits a wall.
Next Thing Technologies is building the infrastructure that could make it possible.1

# **[Musk bets a billion humanoids will outwork the species.](https://substack.com/redirect/d2702e12-cebd-4f5c-bd1f-38b602de89e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Elon Musk told the G20 Innovation Ministerial in Chapel Hill the over-under is 1 billion humanoid robots in 10 years. Robots building robots. Starts slow, then explodes. Each unit five times a human's output, a bet he will put serious money on. That fleet, he claims, outproduces every human on earth. Sermon, not a shipping report.
* **Winners?** Tesla if Optimus leaves the Academy and hits a factory clock. Actuator, reducer, and memory suppliers already pouring lines aimed at a million-unit ramp.
* **Losers?** Labor-heavy incumbents who think a decade is plenty of time. Anyone still valuing Tesla as a car company with a science-fair robot in the lobby.
* **Next?** Watch Fremont conversion and second-half 2026 Academy units, not the podium math. If bodies do not ship, the 1 billion line becomes another promise the multiple eats.

Musk also said AI lifts the global economy 20% to 30%, or $20 trillion to $30 trillion a year. Talk is cheap. Last look, Optimus was still an early-stage promise while Tesla capex sat north of $25 billion. A billion bots in ten years is the same bet, louder. Pay for units, not adjectives.

# **[Dyson wants $499 to put a camera in your mouth.](https://substack.com/redirect/d2702e12-cebd-4f5c-bd1f-38b602de89e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Dyson just dropped a $499 CameraJet toothbrush with a built-in camera and an AI jet that hunts the gaps where plaque starts. Blue or pink. Preorder now. Six years of R&D so you can skip flossing and watch your gums on the MyDyson app. Oral-B and Philips already sold smart brushes. Dyson put a camera in your mouth.
* **Winners?** Dyson's personal-care machine. Hair tools already hit 30% of U.S. sales by 2023. The $100 HushJet Mini has been selling out since April. Premium vanity prints cash.
* **Losers?** Anyone paying $499 to film their molars. Also the 85% of people a study said had never heard of smart toothbrushes. That is a gift-shop SKU, not a category.
* **Next?** Preorders tell the truth by Christmas. If CameraJet sits with the dead washing machine and the killed EV, it was theater. If it ships, a $300 knockoff follows.

This is late-cycle consumer tech stamping AI on the box. Cameras in glasses, pendants, now enamel. Dyson can sell expensive air and expensive hair. A half-grand toothbrush with a spy cam is a margin experiment, not a category kill. Rich people will buy the pink one. The floss industry will survive.

The foldable and the September 9 launch are his opening bid. Losers? OpenAI's hardware shop and the ex-Apple hands Apple says walked secrets out. Tang Tan and Chang Liu are named. Cook's political magic does not transfer in a box. Next? September 9 is the first exam. New Siri has to work. The OpenAI fight gets uglier. If the foldable slips or AI still looks rented, the grace period dies. We called this war in "Apple's lawsuit screams AI hardware is the iPhone makers future" Monday's filings prove it. Apple says OpenAI is destroying evidence. OpenAI calls the case baseless and says its ChatGPT device can unseat the iPhone. Control the hardware or watch the pins eat lunch. Ternus ships a real AI device or manages decline in nicer aluminum. The Capitalist "Alright, pay attention because this is how legends are made... 2 months ago 133 likes 1 comment The Capitalist The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you! Hut 8 popped as much as 4% premarket after the Journal said Anthropic signed a $35 billion cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda. Hut 8 is building the Nueces County, Texas campus Nvidia will lease. Used to mine bitcoin. Now it turns scarce power into 15-year AI leases. Benchmark's Mark Palmer is at $195. That is about 143% upside. Winners? Hut 8, Nvidia, and Lambda. Asher Genoot already locked a $7 billion Fluidstack lease and a $9.8 billion Beacon Point deal that can stretch to $25.1 billion. Losers? Late bitcoin-miner tourists still pricing Hut 8 as a hash-rate toy. Also the cash-burning labs that have to rent this iron because they never built their own. Next? More late-stage Hut 8 projects hit the tape. Power-first campuses in Texas and Louisiana become collateral the Street can underwrite. Watts get bid, not white papers. This is the grab we flagged in "Anthropic begs Meta for a compute life raft after Musk Colossus hookup" They were starving for Nvidia iron. Now they wrote a $35 billion check through Lambda and parked it on Hut 8 dirt. Winners hoard electrons. Valuations follow the power bill. Load contracted megawatts, not chatbot sermons. The Capitalist "Alright, pay attention because this is how legends are made... a month ago 109 likes 4 comments The Capitalist Elon Musk told the G20 Innovation Ministerial in Chapel Hill the over-under is 1 billion humanoid robots in 10 years. Robots building robots. Starts slow, then explodes. Each unit five times a human's output, a bet he will put serious money on. That fleet, he claims, outproduces every human on earth. Sermon, not a shipping report. Winners? Tesla if Optimus leaves the Academy and hits a factory clock. Actuator, reducer, and memory suppliers already pouring lines aimed at a million-unit ramp. Losers? Labor-heavy incumbents who think a decade is plenty of time. Anyone still valuing Tesla as a car company with a science-fair robot in the lobby. Next? Watch Fremont conversion and second-half 2026 Academy units, not the podium math. If bodies do not ship, the 1 billion line becomes another promise the multiple eats. Musk also said AI lifts the global economy 20% to 30%, or $20 trillion to $30 trillion a year. Talk is cheap. Last look, Optimus was still an early-stage promise while Tesla capex sat north of $25 billion. A billion bots in ten years is the same bet, louder. Pay for units, not adjectives. Dyson just dropped a $499 CameraJet toothbrush with a built-in camera and an AI jet that hunts the gaps where plaque starts. Blue or pink. Preorder now. Six years of R&D so you can skip flossing and watch your gums on the MyDyson app. Oral-B and Philips already sold smart brushes. Dyson put a camera in your mouth. Winners? Dyson's personal-care machine. Hair tools already hit 30% of U.S. sales by 2023. The $100 HushJet Mini has been selling out since April. Premium vanity prints cash. Losers? Anyone paying $499 to film their molars. Also the 85% of people a study said had never heard of smart toothbrushes. That is a gift-shop SKU, not a category. Next? Preorders tell the truth by Christmas. If CameraJet sits with the dead washing machine and the killed EV, it was theater. If it ships, a $300 knockoff follows. This is late-cycle consumer tech stamping AI on the box. Cameras in glasses, pendants, now enamel. Dyson can sell expensive air and expensive hair. A half-grand toothbrush with a spy cam is a margin experiment, not a category kill. Rich people will buy the pink one. The floss industry will survive. ---|---|---
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stands in front of a Hermes 900 drone at the Palmachim Airbase near the city of Rishon LeZion on July 5, 2023. Photo by Jack Guez/AFP via Getty Images.
Uganda's parliament last month authorized an unprecedented deployment of Ugandan soldiers to Gaza as part of an international force proposed by President Donald Trump's Board of Peace.
"The President of the Republic of Uganda is ready to deploy in the Gaza Strip," Defense Minister Kiryowa Kiwanuka told lawmakers in a parliamentary debate about the deployment, saying a formal status-of-forces agreement would be negotiated after parliamentary approval. The vote on the measure came after Israel [said](https://substack.com/redirect/cccf220e-79db-419a-a56e-a12abff8fd5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that troops from "friendly countries" could participate in the mission.
The Ugandan government has so far offered no clear public explanation for why it volunteered for the mission, what role its soldiers would play, or what Kampala expects in return. The proposal has raised questions from members of the country's parliament, including opposition lawmaker Hassan Kirumira, who asked during the debate, "On which side is our army going to fight?'"
The decision to send Ugandan troops did not emerge in a vacuum, but comes amid a rapidly expanding security relationship between Tel Aviv and Kampala that included the 2022 signing of a formal defense-cooperation agreement between the two countries.
Internal documents reviewed by Drop Site News reveal for the first time the details of a years-long program by Israeli weapons manufacturer Elbit Systems, the country's largest weapons maker, to equip the Ugandan military with an expanding fleet of Hermes surveillance drones, as well as a suite of advanced surveillance systems intended for use by Uganda's Military Intelligence and elite Special Forces Command (SFC)--a branch of the country's security establishment tied to the family of President Yoweri Museveni, and his son Muhoozi Kainerugaba.
Details of the relationship come from an archive of hacked emails and documents from Elbit executive Vered Haimovich, a former Israeli military officer who became vice president of Elbit Systems' UAV Systems Business Unit in January 2021. The archive was published by Distributed Denial of Secrets and released by Handala, an online hacking group believed to be tied to the Iranian Ministry of Intelligence. Drop Site conducted cryptographic verification on emails contained in the archive as well as verifying non-public material it contained.
In response to a request for comment, an Elbit spokesperson said, "Elbit Systems does not comment on business matters relating to its customers. The materials presented do not accurately reflect the company's business activities."
The Ugandan government did not respond to questions.
Uganda's ownership of Elbit's Hermes 900 was first publicly documented in February 2022, when Kainerugaba [posted](https://substack.com/redirect/e01b05d9-072f-45fc-b83e-e375c229811f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) footage of Ugandan soldiers inside an aircraft hangar singing and clapping in front of the drone on social media with the comment "Ugandan special forces warming up for another mission in Operation Shujaa!" a reference to Uganda's military intervention in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7515c167-e068-4fa1-bd8d-484d6e8485d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Later reports [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/a7015f61-e92c-46b5-ba92-9aaceda13451?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the country operated "at least two dozen" of the aircraft supplied in 2019, though no details or corroboration were provided. In August 2024, a drone bearing Ugandan markings crashed in eastern Congo and was later [identified](https://substack.com/redirect/3da0ec17-69bc-4574-a562-a4745a001f37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by a United Nations Group of Experts report as a Hermes 900.
Despite prior evidence of military cooperation between Israel and Uganda, details about the exact nature and scale of the cooperation between Elbit and Kampala, including the scale of cooperation on the Ugandan drone program, have not previously been disclosed.
The records contained in the email archive identify lucrative contracts for the sale of military surveillance systems and other equipment from Elbit to Uganda, including a signed $52.1 million package for four Hermes 900 aircraft and supporting infrastructure dated March 2024. The documents, marked as confidential, also reveal other intelligence and weapons systems offered by Elbit to Ugandan Military Intelligence and the SFC in particular--an elite branch of the security services involved in the protection of the Museveni family and formerly commanded by Kainerugaba himself, the country's current military chief.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40c91874-6044-4462-a022-aa9da00d0819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_A page from a March 2024 agreement for the provision of Hermes 900 systems and supporting infrastructure from Elbit Systems to Ugandan military intelligence and Special Forces Command. Machine translation provided by Drop Site._
The systems offered included advanced surveillance equipment capable of monitoring large areas continuously, intercepting communications, and producing radar images at night and through cloud cover. The documents also point to the previous sale of Israeli loitering munitions--also known as suicide drones--and other equipment used to carry out offensive operations.
In recent years, Uganda has become one of Africa's most active military powers. Ugandan forces currently operate on missions in Somalia, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and South Sudan.
In 2025, Uganda deployed special forces to support South Sudanese President Salva Kiir's government--an operation in which Ugandan forces [provided](https://substack.com/redirect/af59d584-71f7-4ae0-a4ee-c4574168c457?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) aerial support during "repeated attacks that resulted in the killing and maiming of civilians, including children suffering severe burns consistent with incendiary bombs," according to a United Nations inquiry.
Uganda's relationship with Israel has continued to grow closer since the reestablishment of ties between the two countries in a 1994 normalization agreement signed by Museveni, who has been president since 1986.
Just days before the August 6 parliamentary vote approving the deployment of Ugandan troops to Gaza, Kainerugaba [unveiled](https://substack.com/redirect/1f74daff-522b-4f4f-bcee-62cd14948ebe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a monument at Entebbe airport to Yonatan Netanyahu, the older brother of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who was killed while commanding a 1976 hostage-rescue operation at the airport.
In a since-deleted social media [post](https://substack.com/redirect/4afd085d-a1b0-44e4-8ed3-922e2a529d76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Kainerugaba suggested that the decision to build the statue in honor of Netanyahu had been divinely inspired. "For the last 4 years, My God Jesus Christ has appeared to me in dreams and visions. He told me to build a monument to Yoni Netanyahu in Entebbe. And not to fear the world. He is stronger than the world!" he wrote.
## **Surveillance and Strike**
In February 2022, when Kainerugaba [posted](https://substack.com/redirect/e01b05d9-072f-45fc-b83e-e375c229811f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the footage on social media showing Ugandan soldiers with the Hermes 900, the revelation that Uganda's military was operating the aircraft came as a surprise to many defense analysts. A report in the military intelligence publication Janes quickly [identified](https://substack.com/redirect/ba5cfada-9e27-4092-83fa-4b3391f116d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the drone as the Hermes 900, describing it as a "previously undocumented" Ugandan capability provided by Israel.
Despite the revelation, little reliable information existed about when Kampala obtained the Hermes aircraft, or the number it had in its possession. Open-source information also indicated that Elbit had also provided mortars and other munitions used by Ugandan forces during the conflict in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
The correspondence and documents contained in the email archive indicate that Elbit was not simply a hardware supplier but an active partner over several years with Kampala in building an integrated surveillance architecture, constructing drone bases, and developing the infrastructure to carry out offensive strikes.
A September 2021 Elbit pricing sheet labeled "Uganda" describes a $16.1 million package that included two new Hermes 900 aircraft, maintenance for an additional Hermes 450 already in-country, ground-control systems, training assistance, as well as additional support with maintenance and spare parts that raised the overall price to $18.4 million.
Later that month, according to another document, Elbit and Yamasec Ltd., an aviation and security contractor operating in Uganda, signed what they called an "alignment" agreement settling disputes surrounding three earlier contracts, which revealed more details about the timing and scope of the relationship between Elbit and Uganda.
Yamasec did not respond to a request for comment.
The alignment document indicates that the Ugandan program began with Elbit providing a refurbished Hermes 450 system--an older model of the aircraft--contracted in January 2019, followed by two more refurbished systems in 2020 and 2021.
Under the agreement settling disputes over three earlier deals, Elbit was to deliver one refurbished and two new Hermes 900 aircraft, supply two new Hermes 450s, and upgrade the entire fleet's control trailers and communications links. Shipping terms specified delivery of the requested systems and aircraft to Entebbe, Uganda.
Additional documents in the archive suggest that the agreements continued to expand in later years to include more significant expansions of Uganda's capabilities.
A signed eight-page March 2024 contract outlines details for a $52.1 million deal to sell four Hermes 900 drones equipped with Elbit's SkEye wide-area surveillance system and accompanying ground-based surveillance systems. The document notes that $14.2 million had already been transferred to Elbit from Uganda in 2021, and would be credited toward expansion of the deal.
In addition to specifying the terms for expanding drone capabilities, the contract also includes references to other weaponry and surveillance equipment that Elbit was providing to Uganda under separate contracts, including a AES-210 electronic-intelligence system awaiting installation in Uganda, as well as a SkyStriker system operated by the Ugandan military. [SkyStriker](https://substack.com/redirect/079a2eec-82bb-4aaa-8781-8176c5bba54b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is Elbit's signature loitering munition--a reference to a remotely operated weapon outfitted with a warhead designed to search for and strike targets with precision by crashing into them.
The contract for the expanded cooperation was signed by a company named DeepSight Limited as Elbit's direct customer, while identifying the Government of Uganda, Military Intelligence, and the SFC, as the end users.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/31aed010-15a0-4c22-92a6-7bdb64c2933f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Slide from January 2022 internal Elbit Systems management presentation. Machine translation provided by Drop Site._
The archive also contains evidence that Elbit was preparing to provide more advanced offensive weapons upgrades to Uganda. A management presentation circulated internally at the beginning of January 2022 states under the heading "Uganda" that the company was "preparing to conduct weapons drops (including Lizard 3) at the beginning of January," subject to Covid restrictions. Lizard 3 is an Elbit [laser-guidance kit](https://substack.com/redirect/1f797e39-871a-4674-bca2-6f342f51b09d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the company markets to help "convert general-purpose bombs into precision-guided weapons."
In addition to extensive sales of weapons and surveillance systems, the documents suggest Elbit was providing Uganda with help developing physical bases to operate the Hermes 900 drones and accompanying ground-based infrastructure. A July 2021 contract in the archive contains information on an order for three ground-based OPATS units for a drone base--equipment intended to automate the takeoff and landing of drones--and prices a spare-parts package to support Ugandan operations at a second base.
The basing infrastructure also appeared to set the stage for ongoing charges to the Ugandan government for support from Elbit for their military operations, while also giving a picture of the pace of expansion of the Hermes 900 fleet. Under "future options," the same document lists a $2.3 million Hermes 900 spare-parts package to support the additional base and anticipated future maintenance charges for two existing aircraft beginning in November 2022 and a fleet of three to five aircraft beginning a year later.
## **Operational Problems**
Despite the enthusiasm on both sides of the deal to expand the relationship, the emails also reveal serious operational problems in deploying Israeli military equipment in Uganda.
In an email message accompanying the signed 2021 alignment agreement, a representative from Yamasec told Elbit representatives that a Hermes 900 ground-control trailer had flooded and that operations had been halted as a result. "This is simply unreasonable--it is supposed to be milspec," they wrote, using an abbreviation to denote military standards.
Despite the complaints and alleged shortcomings in fulfilling the contracts, Yamasec proposed more deals to purchase equipment from Elbit, including a proposal to connect the entire Hermes drone fleet to a proposed intelligence center capable of processing and analyzing the information collected by the aircraft and helping Ugandan security forces "close loops"--military terminology for turning raw data into operational intelligence to carry out attacks.

Israel has had a complex relationship with Uganda over the past several decades. After Amin took power in a 1971 coup, Israel initially backed his government. But the following year Amin severed relations with Tel Aviv after Israel rejected his requests for Phantom fighter aircraft to use in a conflict against Tanzania, turning instead to Libya for military and financial support, and attempting to refashion himself as a supporter of the Palestinian cause.
Relations between Tel Aviv and Kampala reached their lowest point during the 1976 Entebbe hostage crisis, and were only reestablished by Museveni in 1994. Security, intelligence, and military cooperation have deepened since then, culminating in the renewed defense-cooperation agreement in 2022.
The support that Elbit has provided to the SFC commanded by Kainerugaba, and its role in shoring up the dynastic power of the Museveni family, offers some additional insight into the increasingly vociferous support that the country's leadership has offered Tel Aviv, which could soon include the deployment of Ugandan troops to the Gaza Strip.
At the early August ceremony unveiling the monument to Yonatan Netanyahu at Entebbe airport, Kainerugaba [honored](https://substack.com/redirect/daf10c43-e43c-4ede-86af-0b268edd0b7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Israeli commando and brother of the current prime minister who died in the raid that also killed several dozen Ugandan soldiers, while praising Kampala's expanding relationship with Tel Aviv.
"Monuments are more than stone and bronze," Kainerugaba said. "They preserve memory, teach history, and inspire future generations. This monument, therefore, carries significance far beyond commemorating one brave individual."

Meet one of
Trump's crony nominees for the federal bench: Daniel Ballou.

Not only is he a Trump loyalist, but he was caught breaking the code of
conduct he swore to uphold.

During his time as a judge in Kentucky, he funneled money to a political
campaign and blasted a mass email to dozens of judges pushing a Senate
candidate’s campaign material — rallying support on the candidate’s
behalf.

Kentucky’s own Judicial Conduct Commission charged him with violating the
Code of Judicial Conduct — for failing to uphold the basic standards of
judicial integrity, and for playing politics from the bench.

And now, Trump nominated him for a lifetime judgeship.

Judges are supposed to be independent. They're supposed to rule on the
law, not out of obligation to the man who put them there. Ballou already
showed Kentucky he can't keep politics out of his courtroom. Yet Trump
wants to hand him a black robe and a lifetime appointment anyway.

This is what Trump's court takeover looks like. Judges who owe him more
than they owe the Constitution. Judges who'll push his extremist agenda
through the courts. Judges he can fall back on to protect him.

What a month.

| | | | |
---
Peter,
August was a month I will not forget. Here is a look at what we got up to, and none of it would have been possible without you.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Yeaj36Ytdmyk0hp4ygZ2hQ~~/AAUS1hA~/LJycuVRyUJomiqKkLkjw2y2N3rm7BWdTTakCvjAbFGB3lWVfeidvvcJBDoaR8hSpFQ8Kif8xBedFaLoX33ioCvFH3pGt0H-SCCDze1VNf6VcbVGDs7HGVcTz9nyAHuzPl2sQAGbiH7s3QVtNGhfk5W2RE7oiIeJv_7CuDPEysIaIklROGDZTgN3kBFLDiKtO4Bp1wx3HWykmi8NnNzvKX_nzymzNLOLT5OQd1203b2bzH8oPxZDvUS7ojqRQujJN)
I got to spend my birthday in Columbia with Liz and the kids, and the people who have gotten me where I am today. There is nowhere I would rather have celebrated, and no community I am more grateful for than my hometown.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Yeaj36Ytdmyk0hp4ygZ2hQ~~/AAUS1hA~/LJycuVRyUJomiqKkLkjw2y2N3rm7BWdTTakCvjAbFGB3lWVfeidvvcJBDoaR8hSpFQ8Kif8xBedFaLoX33ioCvFH3pGt0H-SCCDze1VNf6VcbVGDs7HGVcTz9nyAHuzPl2sQAGbiH7s3QVtNGhfk5W2RE7oiIeJv_7CuDPEysIaIklROGDZTgN3kBFLDiKtO4Bp1wx3HWykmi8NnNzvKX_nzymzNLOLT5OQd1203b2bzH8oPxZDvUS7ojqRQujJN)
The Southport Skeet Shoot in Maury County is one of those traditions that reminds you why Tennessee is worth fighting for. I have been going since I was 14. Some things never get old.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Yeaj36Ytdmyk0hp4ygZ2hQ~~/AAUS1hA~/LJycuVRyUJomiqKkLkjw2y2N3rm7BWdTTakCvjAbFGB3lWVfeidvvcJBDoaR8hSpFQ8Kif8xBedFaLoX33ioCvFH3pGt0H-SCCDze1VNf6VcbVGDs7HGVcTz9nyAHuzPl2sQAGbiH7s3QVtNGhfk5W2RE7oiIeJv_7CuDPEysIaIklROGDZTgN3kBFLDiKtO4Bp1wx3HWykmi8NnNzvKX_nzymzNLOLT5OQd1203b2bzH8oPxZDvUS7ojqRQujJN)
We took to the doors in Williamson County with a great group of volunteers. This is how you win a race like this one, one conversation at a time.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Yeaj36Ytdmyk0hp4ygZ2hQ~~/AAUS1hA~/LJycuVRyUJomiqKkLkjw2y2N3rm7BWdTTakCvjAbFGB3lWVfeidvvcJBDoaR8hSpFQ8Kif8xBedFaLoX33ioCvFH3pGt0H-SCCDze1VNf6VcbVGDs7HGVcTz9nyAHuzPl2sQAGbiH7s3QVtNGhfk5W2RE7oiIeJv_7CuDPEysIaIklROGDZTgN3kBFLDiKtO4Bp1wx3HWykmi8NnNzvKX_nzymzNLOLT5OQd1203b2bzH8oPxZDvUS7ojqRQujJN)
We launched Moms for Molder in Franklin. As a husband and a father, family is always front and center for me, and that’s why I am so proud of Moms for Molder, and I look forward to watching this group pick up steam across TN-5!
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Yeaj36Ytdmyk0hp4ygZ2hQ~~/AAUS1hA~/LJycuVRyUJomiqKkLkjw2y2N3rm7BWdTTakCvjAbFGB3lWVfeidvvcJBDoaR8hSpFQ8Kif8xBedFaLoX33ioCvFH3pGt0H-SCCDze1VNf6VcbVGDs7HGVcTz9nyAHuzPl2sQAGbiH7s3QVtNGhfk5W2RE7oiIeJv_7CuDPEysIaIklROGDZTgN3kBFLDiKtO4Bp1wx3HWykmi8NnNzvKX_nzymzNLOLT5OQd1203b2bzH8oPxZDvUS7ojqRQujJN)
Back on the ground in Memphis, talking to voters in their neighborhoods and hearing directly about what the chaos in Washington is doing to their lives. Every door we knocked reminded me exactly why we are in this.
November 3rd is coming fast. Thank you for an incredible August. Let's go make September count.
— Chaz

name: Carrie Anne
subject: Finally! Meet the Forward candidates & text banking is LIVE
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Open me for party news you can use!

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=1)
---
| Hello Forward Friends- It's that time of year! The election is two months away, and we are in full campaign mode. Our [volunteer dashboard](https://home.forwardparty.com/your_dashboard?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=2) has been updated to offer you direct links to our candidates' volunteer signups, and text banking, which is live! If you want to know more about who we are supporting this cycle, I've got you covered. We have three "_Meet the Forwardists_ " events planned, and all the Committees will be hosting candidate panels as well. We'll also have weekly [**Forward Text Force**](https://home.forwardparty.com/text_banking_volunteer_sign_up?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=3) meetings. This will be your chance to get onboarded, ask questions about the candidates, and troubleshoot any technical issues with me. We plan to send out close to half a million texts this year, so we definitely need your help! | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/meet_the_forwardists_2026?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=4 "RSVP to Meet the Forwardists!") [RSVP to Meet the Forwardists!](https://home.forwardparty.com/meet_the_forwardists_2026?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=4)
---
**_Volunteer Spotlight:_**
Our Volunteer of the Month for September is **Chris Scott** in Utah! He has stepped up to help the team there with parade organization and lobbying at the State Capitol, all very important work. When asked why he spends his time doing this, Chris said, "A majority of Americans want a __viable__ third political party. To me, _viable_ means less national drama, and more local results for people. I truly believe Forward can influence that and stabilize our politics. I work hard so our fellow citizens discover that we exist and associate us with being _viable_." Thank you, Chris, for helping make us a viable party!
**_Upcoming virtual events:_**
**Tues Sept 8th @ 7:30pm ET** \- [National Volunteer Call](https://home.forwardparty.com/national_volunteer_call_20260908?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=5)
* Your first stop to updates on the National party and how to plug into the work. We have so many new things to share that you may want to attend this again even if you have before!

**Thurs Sept 10th @ 6:30pm ET-** [Forward Text Force](https://home.forwardparty.com/fwd_text_force_wk_1?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=6)
* Every Thurs until the election we will gather to onboard people to our text banking platform and send texts for our candidates together!

**Thurs Sept 10th @ 8pm ET** \- [Meet the Forwardists, Round 1](https://home.forwardparty.com/meet_the_forwardists_2026?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=7)
* This first week will focus on candidates running on the Forward ballot line from various states and for different levels of office, and will be hosted by **Chuck Todd**!

**Wed Sept 16th @ 8pm ET** \- [Women's Committee Candidate Panel](https://home.forwardparty.com/wc_candidate_panel?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=8)
* Meet impressive female candidates from all different parties!

You can find more things to do on our events [calendar.](https://home.forwardparty.com/public_calendar?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=9)
**_In person events:_**
We are working on some in person volunteer deployments this season. If you are interested in traveling to support Forward please respond to this email and let me know!
Join us in **Myrtle Beach, SC** the weekend of**Sept 18-20th** for a [Forward Friends Meetup](https://home.forwardparty.com/forward_friends_myrtle_beach_meetup?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=10) and [a day of canvassing](https://home.forwardparty.com/sc_canvas_for_fwd?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=11).
**_Staying connected:_**
We have so much happening that you'll be hearing again from me in 2 weeks. You can also[ join our volunteer slack](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=OO1xB82Dwc0SwW5xslNAtwt7PTetSMCyw-nedLBDPmef1qA3M1FMeeWxJSFy3DiyzrOpVEzARq9FXPnjMizoqjrSj2pkDZ-fY7AQF5-sKoI_XxbZ_mEwBbyiiXwn8PuXddFS3fdr2nbaKR2zWsWpUw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=12) for faster updates on events and the ability to connect with other volunteers.
I really appreciate everyone that opens this newsletter and tries to attend our events. I do all this for you!
Have a safe and fun Labor Day,
With gratitude,
Carrie Anne
[https://home.forwardparty.com/](https://home.forwardparty.com/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_sept_1&n=13)

| | _With just seven days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 7, I am highlighting the need to lower property taxes for Granite Staters._
* * *
Dear David, Everything costs more under Donald Trump’s leadership. Gas. Groceries. Childcare. Healthcare. Housing. You name it. **So the last thing Granite Staters need is to also be crushed by sky-high property taxes.** Unfortunately, Granite Staters don’t have the partners we need in Concord or in Washington to bring them down. We deserve so much better. **[We need courageous leaders in Concord and Washington to keep the needs of working families in mind when making decisions about our future. That’s what I’m running for Congress to do. Can you help me get there by pitching in today?](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/HqCVroH9U2QMvlJXbR2LiQ~~/AAUS1hA~/1RGsOqcl71MWheKv3fKZs_DIbtBuiDEfjd8Jt68qq0gAVXHi_lh3AmHFDPcI7jPzoz87C1pQItJHl6AT-rWBzqvmz4Tu5DSZ_5zbA6FKJ5yDe0V7BmRjQYepUjzaYT3oFVpNpuij-U69yS0omgbcels97BsazKIb-Ata_GSVGCqYhXloiDmSahjrWn-O6KxKOnDcgFuRYP-3uha_Wm8OOO1e2AuHuxSBReIxv-JDD_17ELtx5KNrJ8zbXX8rn4fY7H6PPbKoHQDDIMMuM0Gtrw~~)** | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/HqCVroH9U2QMvlJXbR2LiQ~~/AAUS1hA~/1RGsOqcl71MWheKv3fKZs_DIbtBuiDEfjd8Jt68qq0gAVXHi_lh3AmHFDPcI7jPzoz87C1pQItJHl6AT-rWBzqvmz4Tu5DSZ_5zbA6FKJ5yDe0V7BmRjQYepUjzaYT3oFVpNpuij-U69yS0omgbcels97BsazKIb-Ata_GSVGCqYhXloiDmSahjrWn-O6KxKOnDcgFuRYP-3uha_Wm8OOO1e2AuHuxSBReIxv-JDD_17ELtx5KNrJ8zbXX8rn4fY7H6PPbKoHQDDIMMuM0Gtrw~~)

Last fall, after Hampton’s reassessment, hundreds of residents packed the basement of the town hall where I chair the Select Board to talk about their property tax horror stories.
We heard from a retiree who lives in a mobile home and can’t afford to pay an additional thousand dollars a year on her tax bill, and a neighbor who had to choose between paying for his heating oil and his property taxes.
**I hear stories like this all the time on the campaign trail, but it shouldn't be this way.**
Do you want to know one area where we can make a sizable difference in bringing down property taxes? **Public Education.**
New Hampshire ranks dead last in state funding for public schools. When the federal government cuts funding, the costs don’t just disappear. They land on towns, and towns push them onto families through higher property taxes.
Here’s where it gets specific: Congress passed the _Individuals with Disabilities Education Act_ over fifty years ago and promised to cover 40% of special education costs. **It’s never come close to doing that, David.**
Special education is now one of the single largest cost drivers in local school budgets, and these costs are federally mandated and almost entirely paid by local property taxpayers.
Granite Staters are tired of paying higher property taxes because our leaders pass laws and then pass the buck. Our budget in Hampton just failed for the _second_ time in four years because residents can’t take another increase.
**That’s why when I get to Congress, I’m going to fight to fully fund IDEA and provide federal funding for critical local infrastructure programs so we can bring down property taxes.**
**[We’re paying more in New Hampshire while getting less because of the choices that our leaders in the statehouse and in Congress are making. More of the same won’t fix this, so if you’re ready to give Granite Staters the leadership they deserve, I’d be grateful if you could make a donation to my campaign today:](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/HqCVroH9U2QMvlJXbR2LiQ~~/AAUS1hA~/1RGsOqcl71MWheKv3fKZs_DIbtBuiDEfjd8Jt68qq0gAVXHi_lh3AmHFDPcI7jPzoz87C1pQItJHl6AT-rWBzqvmz4Tu5DSZ_5zbA6FKJ5yDe0V7BmRjQYepUjzaYT3oFVpNpuij-U69yS0omgbcels97BsazKIb-Ata_GSVGCqYhXloiDmSahjrWn-O6KxKOnDcgFuRYP-3uha_Wm8OOO1e2AuHuxSBReIxv-JDD_17ELtx5KNrJ8zbXX8rn4fY7H6PPbKoHQDDIMMuM0Gtrw~~)**

clean_body: An issue a day | | | | With just seven days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 7, I am highlighting the need to lower property taxes for Granite Staters. Dear David, Everything costs more under Donald Trump’s leadership. Gas. Groceries. Childcare. Healthcare. Housing. You name it. So the last thing Granite Staters need is to also be crushed by sky-high property taxes. Unfortunately, Granite Staters don’t have the partners we need in Concord or in Washington to bring them down. We deserve so much better. ~~ | | ~~ Last fall, after Hampton’s reassessment, hundreds of residents packed the basement of the town hall where I chair the Select Board to talk about their property tax horror stories. We heard from a retiree who lives in a mobile home and can’t afford to pay an additional thousand dollars a year on her tax bill, and a neighbor who had to choose between paying for his heating oil and his property taxes. I hear stories like this all the time on the campaign trail, but it shouldn't be this way. Do you want to know one area where we can make a sizable difference in bringing down property taxes? Public Education. New Hampshire ranks dead last in state funding for public schools. When the federal government cuts funding, the costs don’t just disappear. They land on towns, and towns push them onto families through higher property taxes. Here’s where it gets specific: Congress passed the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act over fifty years ago and promised to cover 40% of special education costs. It’s never come close to doing that, David. Special education is now one of the single largest cost drivers in local school budgets, and these costs are federally mandated and almost entirely paid by local property taxpayers. Granite Staters are tired of paying higher property taxes because our leaders pass laws and then pass the buck. Our budget in Hampton just failed for the second time in four years because residents can’t take another increase. That’s why when I get to Congress, I’m going to fight to fully fund IDEA and provide federal funding for critical local infrastructure programs so we can bring down property taxes. ~~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | ~ ~ | ~ | ~~ Every contribution helps us fight for our neighbors who deserve to be able to afford to live in the communities they love. | | | Eight years ago, I became the first openly gay person elected to the Michigan State Senate.
---
The Senate was talking about us. It was making decisions for us. But it wasn’t actually listening to us.
If you’re not at the table, oftentimes you find yourself on the menu.
I ran and won, and brought our voice into the rooms where decisions about us are being made.
**Now I'm running for Congress in Michigan's 11th District, and if we win in November, I'll be the first openly gay member of Congress in Michigan history.**
That barrier has stood for as long as Michigan has sent people to Washington. It doesn't break on its own. It breaks because people decide to do the work, election after election.
In 2023, I stood on the floor of the Michigan Senate and led the fight to pass a bill that Republicans had blocked for decades. I sponsored the amendment to Michigan's Elliott-Larsen Civil Rights Act, adding sexual orientation and gender identity as protected classes from discrimination.
That same term, I helped pass a ban on conversion therapy for minors in Michigan, strengthen Michigan’s hate crime law, and make it easier for trans Michiganders to obtain government documents that match their identity.

clean_body: We're taking this fight to Washington. | | | | = | | | Eight years ago, I became the first openly gay person elected to the Michigan State Senate. The Senate was talking about us. It was making decisions for us. But it wasn’t actually listening to us. If you’re not at the table, oftentimes you find yourself on the menu. I ran and won, and brought our voice into the rooms where decisions about us are being made. Now I'm running for Congress in Michigan's 11th District, and if we win in November, I'll be the first openly gay member of Congress in Michigan history. That barrier has stood for as long as Michigan has sent people to Washington. It doesn't break on its own. It breaks because people decide to do the work, election after election. In 2023, I stood on the floor of the Michigan Senate and led the fight to pass a bill that Republicans had blocked for decades. I sponsored the amendment to Michigan's Elliott-Larsen Civil Rights Act, adding sexual orientation and gender identity as protected classes from discrimination. That same term, I helped pass a ban on conversion therapy for minors in Michigan, strengthen Michigan’s hate crime law, and make it easier for trans Michiganders to obtain government documents that match their identity. = | | | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | | = | | Thank you, Jeremy | | | | | | = | | | | | | Paid for by Jeremy Moss for Congress | | Jeremy Moss for Congress 2211 S Telegraph Rd PO Box 7023 Bloomfield Hills, MI 48302 United States | | | | | | | | | | = | | | = | | This message was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | |

With your continued support, we’ve been able to: 🗳️ **Help courageous climate candidates** in some of the most competitive districts in the country take on record spending from dark money groups – and win their primaries. 📩 **Send over 9,000 letters to Congress** and help temporarily pause construction in our treasured Big Bend National Park. ✊ **Prove that despite Trump’s efforts to keep us distracted and exhausted,** we have not taken our eye off November. body:
| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

Fellow Patriot,

We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

Hi team,
Everywhere I go on the campaign trail, from county fairs to swimming pools to picnics, I hear that people are tired. They're tired of the division and the status-quo, do-nothing representation we have.
People want their government to work for them, and it can't do that if it's not working at all. So how do we fix it?
**We start by electing leaders who will get sh*t done.**
That means listening to what matters to our communities and actually doing something to solve our local problems. Rooting out corruption so our representatives work for us instead of for themselves and their mega-donors. Rejecting the kind of toxic, divisive politics we see too much of and working together to make life better for people.
[CHIP IN](https://substack.com/redirect/b6a4b7d8-41a7-4e1c-9c95-34b4df8f9aa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm running to bring people together and get sh*t done. It's how I was raised, and it's what I'll do in Congress. But I can't get there without you.
**Yesterday, you helped us hit our end-of-month goal, and I can 't thank you enough for that. Your support is more critical than ever as we head into the fall.**
We're up against Dan Meuser's war chest of corporate PAC money, so we can't afford to slow down. That's why I have to ask for your help again today.
**[Can you chip in to help us keep up this momentum and deliver real leadership for our part of PA?](https://substack.com/redirect/b6a4b7d8-41a7-4e1c-9c95-34b4df8f9aa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you. Let's get to work.
- Rachel Wallace

We didn't talk about sports or homework. We talked about politics, and about why none of us could ever take this democracy for granted.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138372552/643867887/-279254880?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.09.01_Narrative-Message-2_B1_F1_S1_C1_60OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTY4ZDFlMy00YmE2LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2dO9O7blTNMzKkiLJoupPyx0xZjbDUl-krtdsz6sUCo=)
That upbringing shaped everything that came next.
I didn't set out to run for office. After college, I worked in the Executive Office of UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, on the team that helped deliver the Paris Climate Accords. I saw what's possible when people do the hard work of showing up.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138372553/643867888/-279254880?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.09.01_Narrative-Message-2_B1_F1_S1_C1_60OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTY4ZDFlMy00YmE2LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2dO9O7blTNMzKkiLJoupPyx0xZjbDUl-krtdsz6sUCo=)
**Then Trump got elected. I watched him attack women, working families, immigrants, and our environment, and I knew I couldn't just watch anymore.**
So in 2020, my team and I knocked on tens of thousands of doors together. My mom was right there with us. And when it was all over, I became the youngest woman ever elected to the Phoenix City Council.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138372554/643867889/-279254880?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.09.01_Narrative-Message-2_B1_F1_S1_C1_60OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTY4ZDFlMy00YmE2LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2dO9O7blTNMzKkiLJoupPyx0xZjbDUl-krtdsz6sUCo=)
_We got to work fast:_
* When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, I led the resolution that protected patients and providers from criminalization in our city.
* As Vice Mayor, I expanded housing options, invested in clean transportation, and helped create good-paying jobs.

**I realized there was even more I could do if I was working at the federal level. So I ran. And we won. And last year, I was sworn in as the youngest woman in the 119th Congress, part of a new generation of leaders who refuse to accept business as usual.**
We're facing the fight of our lives, and Arizona is at the center of it. When we win here, we take back the House from a Republican majority that has spent every day leaving Arizona families behind.

body:
If you’re ready to keep going — to keep fighting for justice, for fairness, and for the idea that we rise or fall together — I’d be honored to have you by my side.
Family,

I’m so excited to be running for re-election to the United States Senate in New Jersey and we can’t afford to leave anything on the field. During my first race for Newark Municipal Council, we forced a runoff against the party-machine by just a few hundred votes, so I know that we can’t take any vote for granted in an election as critical as the midterms this November.

This is a moral moment in America. Throughout our nation’s 250 year history, generations have been called to stand up and show that the power of people is always greater than the people in power, and we must answer that call again.

I know that the issues that divide us today are not about left vs. right, it’s about right vs. wrong. The chaos, corruption, and cruelty from Trump’s Washington demands an answer at the ballot box, and I know that millions of you are ready to stand up and speak out.

[**_To defend my seat and flip the Senate we’ll need to use every resource to stand up to Trump’s corrupt machine. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

I was drawn to their mission to end hunger, not just feed people. It was a great fit for me and helped me to build my skills as an advocate for others. At the Capitol in Salem and across the state, I fought for solutions that would help people not have to seek out emergency food assistance – supporting strong minimum wage, affordable housing, and access to health insurance. The people I met and heard from along the way have been my guiding light ever since. That work led me to run for public office and serve in the Oregon Legislature. In my first term, I rewrote the state’s anti-poverty program for low-income families while also securing historic protections for the LGBTQ+ community. Later, when I became Speaker of the House, we raised the minimum wage and passed paid family leave. And as Governor, when Trump tried to strip SNAP benefits from 750,000 Oregonians, I declared a hunger emergency, moved emergency funds to food banks, and my team worked through the night after the courts restored benefits to ensure the money hit people’s accounts by morning. #
Hi there,
With nine weeks to go until Election Day, we just held our second Weekend of Action this year—**and it was our biggest weekend yet!**
This past weekend, Ground Truth volunteers knocked on 3,303 doors, and made 50,117 phone calls. In total, we contacted voters in 25 target races, and we’re still scaling up!
This weekend brings our total Ground Truth deep conversations to more than 15,000. That’s 15,000 substantive conversations with voters, 34% of whom would not be reached in a traditional Democratic field operation.
**The rest of the details in this report are reserved for people actively participating in Ground Truth by canvassing, phone banking, or helping fund the work with a donation. If you’d like to get the full details on the next report, here are two ways you can take action today:**
* [**Click here to find volunteer opportunities near you.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1218?utm_source=em20260901-2644&t=1&akid=2644%2E1562180%2E7MBC3x) You can canvass in a nearby swing district, or make calls to voters from the comfort of your own home!

* [**Click here to make a donation to Ground Truth.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-2025-sl.QSDeHu&refcode=em20260901-2644&t=2&akid=2644%2E1562180%2E7MBC3x) This fund supports Swing Left and will allow us to increase capacity for Ground Truth organizing as we expand across the country.

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026.
