clean_body: They are talking about the very real fear of watching everything we fixed, the border, the economy, our standing in the world, torn apart the moment the Socialist Democrats retake the House and turn Washington into a nonstop impeachment circus. | Fellow American, Everywhere I go in this district, people tell me a version of the same thing. At the grocery store, after church, at the gas pump, they lower their voice a little and say some form of the same sentence: “Please don't let them take it all back.” They are not talking about politics as a game. They are talking about the very real fear of watching everything we fixed, the border, the economy, our standing in the world, torn apart the moment the Socialist Democrats retake the House and turn Washington into a nonstop impeachment circus. I hear that concern, and I carry it with me every day I am in Washington. It is exactly why I refuse to slow down, even in the dead quiet of July. But I cannot wage this fight alone. I need people like you standing behind me. Beth Van Duyne | | PAID FOR BY BETH VAN DUYNE FOR CONGRESS

His name is Tedrick Washington. Former Division I basketball player. Passenger in the backseat of a car he wasn't driving.
He had his hands up.
An Arkansas police officer punched him in the face twice. Then the police report said the officer felt threatened because Tedrick "postured himself as if he was going to strike him."
That's not what's in the video. In the video, his hands are up.
This week on Standing Our Ground I break down exactly what happened, get into RFK Jr.'s quiet gutting of the food safety system and what it's actually costing us, and give you an update from my trip to West Virginia. We are 62 days from Election Day and I have a lot to say.

body:

Peter,
I’m reaching out to say _thank you_. Over the past few days, I’m sure your inbox was full of fundraising requests from different campaigns, including mine.
This summer was a particularly slow one for grassroots fundraising — but thanks to supporters like you, we were able to meet our August goal. And I’m grateful for your continued support.
These goals aren’t arbitrary. I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, which means everything we do on this campaign — from running the Resistance Lab, to organizing here in Seattle, to supporting progressives across the country like Abdul El-Sayed, Will Lawrence, Peggy Flanagan, and Tom Perriello — is powered by grassroots contributions.
In an election cycle when AIPAC has already spent over $100 million coming after progressive candidates, I’m grateful that I can count on this grassroots community to help me fight back and grow our movement.
Thank you again,
— PJ
P.S. With Election Day just 9 weeks away, we’re in a sprint to the finish. Peter: The GOP isn't being coy about what they want to do if they take back the governorship in Arizona this year. **Their plan is to pack the courts with MAGA judges.** The same committee that helps select the state’s judges also controls who sits on the state’s Independent Redistricting Commission — which will determine the makeup of Arizona’s 30 legislative districts and 9 congressional districts after the 2030 census. And ultimately, ensure that Republicans can keep grabbing power without having to be accountable to voters. There's _A LOT_ on the line this November in Arizona and across the country. **It’s why the NDRC is laser-focused on the most critical state-level elections that will affect the long-term fight for our democracy. ** [**It’s why we need your help. subject: Losing
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=8661%2E582294%2EPWY_EG ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=8661%2E582294%2EPWY_EG ]Chris Pappas for Senate

Team,

I want to give you an update on the Senate race here in New Hampshire:

A new UNH poll has John Sununu ahead of us for the first time this entire
campaign.

I’m not going to sugarcoat it: This race is tightening, and we have a lot
of work to do.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260901_3.VkqcTe&refcode=em20260901-3&t=1003&akid=8661%2E582294%2EPWY_EG ]Before I share more, will you step up and pitch in $5 or
whatever makes sense for you today – before our critical monthly
fundraising deadline at midnight tonight – to ensure we have the resources
we need to defend this open Senate seat and prove to the GOP that New
Hampshire can’t be bought?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260901_3.VkqcTe&amount=5&refcode=em20260901-3&t=1022&akid=8661%2E582294%2EPWY_EG ]Donate $5 »

The
stakes are bigger than just this one Senate seat.

Republicans currently hold the Senate 53–47. If Democrats are going to
take back the majority, we have to hold New Hampshire.

I was born and raised here. I know this state, I know Granite Staters, and
I know that people here don’t respond well to being told how they’re
supposed to vote.

They want to know who is going to show up, listen to them, and get things
done.

That’s what I’ve done in Congress, and that’s what this campaign is going
to keep doing between now and Election Day.

John Sununu and the national Republicans supporting him are going to spend
a lot more money in our state. We’re not going to be able to match them
dollar for dollar.

But we don’t need to. We can outwork them.

We can knock more doors. Make more calls. Have more conversations with
voters. And make sure our message reaches every Granite Stater we need to
reach.

That takes people and resources.

We need to keep this campaign fully funded through the final stretch.

This poll is a reminder that we have no time to waste.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260901_3.VkqcTe&refcode=em20260901-3&t=1023&akid=8661%2E582294%2EPWY_EG ]I’m
asking you to chip in $5 today and help us take back the
lead in this race and flip the Senate blue.

Thank you for standing with me.

Chris

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=8661%2E582294%2EPWY_EG

body:
I'm humbly asking you to read this, so you can understand why I care so much about this race
| [ ](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=6527cac2825e4e9b86c78fbc8851322b&_e=Oio2g0YIaFhCq3YoQm0tRu1__wXk-175xba1235W3FHrHvn9W0tyiE5BdMSWd0KPBLd-TjOjBpA2yLJ6Ld2L5G0z21SChPluxmgxaC-b13Fkh-yzU9H7gnMDDDl5R-v3kSauKdl6e3tIM4eDVXPd98ogH05Snsz0fr9mhgyGAGSUeR2S492opyZQiENrcRMtrg8_SG8N5ryECP7T5q4xSSScv31Zy0CgbDOKk66WIAJdocxim8_ZzzEdjfpJmKMjatyqqTNolOt6TLlqVOEuHy2weW5PQfxacu3s_bh6brR4h_NwPfjb8MlcASOqI3ZJNaRKdMaPdpMNa2x7OdLVpZCf2XKOCzopb4UXAqg-kSeAq_GaPsxvXaEQunE0-GUeFAv3c7Wtq1cXUP0w0ouaDskuWSsa6HDid9wnBBhvJfNzhkSREO2wIfiIDvCLq-aRAUSJJ8WTOkeUV58z8mRmDC9LEhv7sxKS69xfubwDBaTi_kTUnvwp4FxPFilh974C77tqzMSLGG4VeaMdzTCVI7ydSF6kTpsqZ6ucnrz_Ugo%3D)

Peter,

**My son, who was a U.S. Marine and father of two, was murdered in 2016 when he was just 28 years old.**

[**This is a longer email, but I humbly ask you to read it and consider joining my team at the end.**](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=6527cac2825e4e9b86c78fbc8851322b&_e=Oio2g0YIaFhCq3YoQm0tRu1__wXk-175xba1235W3FHrHvn9W0tyiE5BdMSWd0KPBLd-TjOjBpA2yLJ6Ld2L5G0z21SChPluxmgxaC-b13Fkh-yzU9H7gnMDDDl5R-v3kSauKdl6e3tIM4eDVXPd98ogH05Snsz0fr9mhgyGAGSUeR2S492opyZQiENrcRMtouesrqQbYhBUl8v5LKn47dyMFHuTH4U_KggyJjo785v02_mq2Qq3CkJ4gZi6LHEFUZhkFaTzPMBR7Oqzy0wqFXuAaWB80wW3TDYUGb1LOfHDmNW98DWRXDIaOOubtuXSCmhs_pv8V4JQvw4P37Zd6LErmLiGjnwdbLih1FYAFCwKV_4sC8ppTSAB5nQTXebqJfndtumSZWMJKRQi0y4kl05ufUWOUnU6RZecbSuISvPRZWqJLuGPdPfX9mxbHxgCPgi7f3SqWuVp3pge4gnZHXtMY6ungT_xOQJqiw1JL8tODhCAUYlFbPEzsgiEuEoSRFsP_Bqy3y9Pha_8dAUjMmeq3RDZZQpxLaYbqhyrWqo%3D)

**In case you don 't know me, my name is Joe Males, and I'm a proud Mexican-American, U.S. Marine Veteran, small business owner, and a city councilman who's running for Congress in CA-25. But above all else, I'm a father who is still in mourning.**

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=6527cac2825e4e9b86c78fbc8851322b&_e=Oio2g0YIaFhCq3YoQm0tRu1__wXk-175xba1235W3FHrHvn9W0tyiE5BdMSWd0KPBLd-TjOjBpA2yLJ6Ld2L5G0z21SChPluxmgxaC-b13Fkh-yzU9H7gnMDDDl5R-v3kSauKdl6e3tIM4eDVXPd98ogH05Snsz0fr9mhgyGAGSUeR2S492opyZQiENrcRMtjeuB-liF_l9O7O9Ud3uRAiqpJ-VQ63h5KyYDiy2NNNsIg_NoaHWr8javAFati3DArFJqqRmBl7gmujE5sG3_UT1e-H0nI_UYsrRjNMrUp8EkaGnlssl00EUbeT0pgZSbp4If-QVKc7X57bnqfBv4skS37lh013UM1S1FoSJgyveepZgazVqaeiE0o79dUcMVXHGG7sjlEtonpiFZCza0iMIhrjHntOyPJnyZzdFvUf1GYGFtajUGbMYP8rjzWEdiYfygiFd651sArBxaGNnf1_Zcu430p1autc5f-H8cWEL57My_8GPYIAIfSNBjcJ62NemRtiubRt40JBKjDijf2pKeICZFkxW88KnCY0ivpZ0%3D)
**I ran for city council and am running for Congress because of my son, Nicholas.**

In 2016, Nicholas came home to visit for his sister's birthday and Father's Day. It was supposed to be a wonderful time to bring our family back together. Then, he was tragically stabbed to death in my hometown of Hemet, California.

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=6527cac2825e4e9b86c78fbc8851322b&_e=Oio2g0YIaFhCq3YoQm0tRu1__wXk-175xba1235W3FHrHvn9W0tyiE5BdMSWd0KPBLd-TjOjBpA2yLJ6Ld2L5G0z21SChPluxmgxaC-b13Fkh-yzU9H7gnMDDDl5R-v3kSauKdl6e3tIM4eDVXPd98ogH05Snsz0fr9mhgyGAGSUeR2S492opyZQiENrcRMt82ZK-WBkTIM63TuJguO3FMUswkqx0GHkS-kNZbEig67oaPsxUPOwu_muhsqYCZANmXR0x5H3w_zdtIw1xaF-E9VY8Gk0001nKzoeYGLEXko2rLX8U6GCMMeCwsdmNlHJwlKy2FpVHREhwu7KS8FEGO82Ec-MFbc7XZiP9grsVvMGgQXXLlSJ-NFsYerTUZleSRwgULi7ao33Qh-sBnCqsvP9CcZV2hAiuT4NrD42WHXNzL5ehcIvytc6EhbR8YAg6JnJyQiwbNjeHqCX68T5ZG_4zc_KkYaxL-YgT7wfG1wwuJVuY2zZcHUvtqX5inK6Zhm1np1rzRn9oW8j3233PLNeN1Dp1zV9l_je1D_owZI%3D)
No one stepped forward with information on my son's killer, so the case went cold. After five years of not knowing anything about what happened, I decided to do something about it. I ran for City Council, and just a few months later, by the grace of God, they found the killer.

As a parent, losing your child is the most difficult thing to go through. But I'm pushing through it and am committed to making him proud as I fight for a better tomorrow for his children.

I'm grateful to Hemet's law enforcement, who was able to find the killer and arrest him.

Nicholas serves as a daily reminder to me to never take a single precious moment for granted and that I must continue to fight every single day for a better future.

clean_body: Sometimes the nonsense is just absolute nonsense. | = Peter, The truth is Donald Trump has spent years telling us who he is, what he believes, and what he is willing to do. Yet somehow, every new outburst gets translated into something more serious, more thoughtful, or more normal than it actually is. We have got to stop laundering this stuff into credibility. Sometimes the ridiculous thing is just the ridiculous thing.Trump has been showing us exactly who he is for a very long time. We HAVE TO believe him. Which brings us to why we’re reaching out today: We are officially TWO MONTHS out from the November election. And I’m going to level with you: Team Becca came up short of our fundraising goal in August. = Nobody here is panicking or hitting the giant red alarm button. But we ARE looking at the calendar. September is here, the election is RIGHT around the corner, and from this point forward, it is all hands on deck. = Becca is out there every single day refusing to normalize the chaos, refusing to give Trump and his allies a pass, and actually fighting for people who deserve a government that functions like it has some damn sense. And now we have about two months to make sure she can keep doing it. We know there are going to be plenty of campaigns asking for your attention between now and November. We know that. But if you appreciate having someone like Becca in Congress who will call this stuff what it is while the pundit class ties itself in knots trying to make Trump sound reasonable, I hope you’ll have her back today! We missed our mark in August.Fine. But September is a new month. We’ve never seen a situation as serious as this one, right now.
#
Peter, we’re deeply concerned about the condition of the United States Army under Pete Hegseth.
We’ve written to you extensively about the purges of officers — firing decorated combat leaders, pushing officers put forward by their peers off of promotion lists, forcing others into retirement. And last week, we learned that the Secretary of the Army resigned after taking his concerns directly to Trump.
Hegseth’s gotten rid of more four-star generals since January 2025 than in the previous 140 years combined. There’s no Senate-confirmed Chief of Staff of the Army, no one leading Transformation and Training Command, no one overseeing US ground troops in Europe, and no Secretary of the Army.
And now, the few senior officers left are actively telling Hegseth that the war he started is compromising our National Security.

I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating.

Because every day, more students are stepping forward.

Not because it's easy or popular...

_But because they know what 's at stake. _

They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to.

They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged.

They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform.

And they're not alone.

They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day.

clean_body: | | | | | Peter, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. But here's what gives me hope, Peter... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... Team Mackenzie,A new report from respected press outlet _Townhall_ raises more serious questions about Bob Brooks and his financial history.The report documents a pattern of financial issues involving Brooks, including **foreclosures, liens, and debt-collection cases** dating back years. Court records cited by _Townhall_ include thousands of dollars in unpaid debts, two separate foreclosure proceedings, and much more. The article also highlights the $130,000 judgment involving Brooks and his former in-laws, which has grown to **more than** **$162,000 because he has refused to pay even after the courts ordered him to!** On August 5, a Northampton County judge ruled that a fraud lawsuit brought by Brooks’ former in-laws could proceed. This report also includes that in 2012, [Wells Fargo filed a foreclosure against Brooks](https://us.list-manage.com/H23q3WE2Zmf?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27). That case was discontinued without prejudice in 2018. That same year, another lien was filed against Brooks, this time involving Midland Funding. [That lien was in the amount of $5,480.84](https://us.list-manage.com/2k17tempbDn?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27). The case remains open, although the status is unclear, but a 2019 filing showed the court had to have a sheriff garnish Brooks' assets to satisfy this debt. **Perhaps most troubling are the questions surrounding Brooks’ federal financial disclosures**. _Townhall_ reports that his original 2025 disclosure did not list the $130,000 court-ordered judgment. The article also reports that Brooks failed to list a pension he has publicly discussed receiving from his 20 years working for the City of Bethlehem, despite divorce records showing a City of Bethlehem retirement account. Why or what is Brooks trying to hide?
---
| [TOWNHALL STORY](https://us.list-manage.com/_A92aUR9A9Z?e=5ccada9200&c2id=772b190546f65300d48df506f9534e27)
---
| | Now, with mail-in voting approaching, Brooks is **avoiding the debate stage**.Ryan has agreed to multiple September debate opportunities so voters can hear directly from both candidates **before** casting their ballots - especially those voters using mail-in ballots. Brooks has declined or ignored those opportunities and instead agreed to an arrangement where part of a debate would air the night before Election Day.The question voters should be asking is simple:**Why is Bob Brooks refusing to face Ryan Mackenzie and answer these questions before people vote?** Ryan is ready to debate. Voters in the Lehigh Valley and Poconos deserve answers, transparency, and accountability — **before they cast a single ballot.**

Breaking News & 3 BIG Announcements
Hello fellow conservatives,

Ending Property Taxes in the State of Florida has been a major focus of mine since I was elected in 2023.

We're turning a big corner on this, so I wanted to share it directly with you an invitation:

NEXT Tuesday, September 8th @ 6:30 p.m., I'd like to invite you to an exclusive LIVE ZOOM event where I will make 3 BIG ANNOUNCEMENTS.

REGISTER for this FREE Live Zoom

https://clicks.aweber.com/y/ct/?l=1fqto&m=iGcDXYgQ7M5liyD&b=yUT2z_KSiLolFgaG4MjYwA

During this event I will set in motion several initiatives that will bring clarity to the total elimination — and replacement — of the most hated tax in America.

Here's why you won't want to miss it:
• You don't own your home — you rent it from the government. Miss one payment on the house you spent your life paying for, and the state can take it and hand it to someone else.
• Our seniors have paid for 30, 40, 50 years — and the bill still comes. That's not a tax. It's a trap.
• The home you leave your kids comes with a chain attached.I want your children and grandchildren to inherit freedom, not a forever-bill from Tallahassee.
A lot of folks have asked me how we could possibly do away with property tax without bankrupting the state. I've got the answers — and they're simpler than you think.

I believe Florida can be the first state in the United States to allow true home ownership. And with your help, we will make history.

body:
Cook Political Report just moved Texas AND Iowa to toss-up on the same day.
Cook Political Report just moved Texas AND Iowa to toss-up on the same day.

| | | | Patriot, The Cook Political Report, the nonpartisan gold standard of election forecasting, just did something I need you to see. They moved Texas from "Lean Republican" to "Toss-Up." Then they moved Iowa from "Lean Republican" to "Toss-Up." _Both. Same day. Less than 75 days before the election._ Cook's own analysis said it plainly: in a wave election, even states that President Trump won by double digits could move within Democrats' reach. That's what they're seeing in Texas and Iowa right now.[ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=ce4f49384e4146bd9b5a52c574bb79b5&_e=QlBUeZ6bzdp51Yw1hLsSqo1bscdzxeQcWbKyIescp5mOSymRpw8pyT0lFu95odX3HDk3KAPvwHdF-zqNHV49kwDZv3T3xz3W02vagKCHZHb45TRaEK56FX3g2FSX0l_zkRCIMtdXPpeuq7qcQ6XgwFA4seHNy9thni5viBjteKEgJwXSLQ2PHEFEBNoTZ81drBDCC1sOcmWCIAgme7zXNU9qxj1MGSR1ViGk9hT36aamq5dOHkhIzn9UYL09SaRaKcF2F4ihStRfUMDtPtQWpmwcELwVOe1Kq3tAF_KLQVa8XvGHQsFX35Gw6XzKiFvRDkZYbtQO5eL4YG7hzSCbomnYb_64asTPVZmxlvAldsEA6MqYZFGEc6ATTvyBSHJ9Hl3Voyq2XixIV3Hi0qdsL_9MrChDAFO5DjNtN5XDFSjI55kFpNPQQEem6euaZGskbhIT_qlB7o-ufTu8zysKrEtXC8nNMNbhwluNetrmVbeqoJaxqRm3XeygB3a6DRPo) Let that sink in. President Trump won both of these states by double-digit margins in 2024. And today, the nonpartisan scorekeepers looked at the data and said: coin flip.[ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=ce4f49384e4146bd9b5a52c574bb79b5&_e=QlBUeZ6bzdp51Yw1hLsSqqobsm0dwyX8qsGoPradqPQdnr_3swuegafBKIGbBdiwtP2u7cMXy6XkxVGiZw9RxwhC0XKsmLNtlExSX3eNN82nP-g7gP3wncLlXhVj5w5KaySYunIGA3kYdUNu0DYEhvHTtGbeylrPgix5JkrSngcXHoTI7k3TkHD2e_E-c2iMzP7lLbdFoXBmFheZrPycbHgso-P2L4PYLoyNn0tfr-3yWAQdhJOljQgK0msaCZxvidH1Ocg5nRvQ2qdp9iFZQSgMoawRsx5P-fSRbKALLDvvhy3xCYHzR7MU24XM1bKvWHQLJzpeY67iNeyai3FToIuyFRB4PRMnKOmXVvdAzj69yIkpWla1BRHCbykRn3NjhRIUiqoKh-ienLvu7p2M0ZGu4PO77DiLaX290eE3c2G2gopR9-33ish32hJd_I7g4FhOJG4sVXpcuLuC3gOlwL-nObdWVLw4Zi7_MOv1SPW51FsHYQDP4EKED_OB0pImecHkWqIYfMIhWH9g9vBxIw%3D%3D) Here's why. James Talarico raised nearly **$30 million on ActBlue over the last three months.** He has been spending his millions of dollars on ads in Texas for months. He has Schumer's full backing, the DSA machine behind him, and more cash than any Democrat Senate candidate in Texas history. In Iowa, Ashley Hinson is facing a well-funded Democrat challenger in a race that has shifted further left than anyone predicted. **Two races. Two toss-ups. And Cook now sees the entire battle for the Senate as a toss-up with Republicans holding only the slimmest of advantages.** I want to be direct with you about what this means. If we lose Texas and Iowa, both states Donald Trump won by double digits and Chuck Schumer has his majority. Your taxes go up. The border opens. Conservative judges get blocked._Everything we've fought for in the last two years gets reversed._ **_This is not a hypothetical. This is the forecast. Right now. Today._** I am fighting for both of these races personally. Cook's own analysis said it plainly: in a wave election, even states that President Trump won by double digits could move within Democrats' reach. That's what they're seeing in Texas and Iowa right now. Let that sink in. President Trump won both of these states by double-digit margins in 2024. September 2, 2026
Recently, Governor Lamont signed an executive order to establish a government committee called the Connecticut Career Pathway Commission, a new advisory board with the mission of finding jobs for Connecticut residents in the changing milieu caused by AI (Artificial Intelligence) and globalism.
According to the Governor's [executive order](https://substack.com/redirect/f6a753c4-5f7d-44cc-87e1-7ff0f38e362c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the commission will consist of "unpaid volunteers" consisting of "leaders from the K-12 and higher education and workforce board systems, employers, labor representatives, municipal leaders, governmental leaders, legislators, community representatives, and students."
The order further states that the Commission will: "Recommend strategies to expand dual enrollment, early college, and the attainment of credentials of value-including industry-recognized credentials, licensure, and certifications; strengthen credit transfer and articulation; ensure that credentialing systems reflect employer needs and labor market demand; and ensure that students are supported with effective education and career advising that helps them navigate multiple high-quality pathway options."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/451f45f3-7f29-422a-bd54-c3a88bbd5a31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The $250,000 man. Miguel Cardona

It is unlikely that this committee will be able to recommend strategies for learning how to write coherently given the above verbiage.
But to put it simply, the purpose of this committee is to recommend how to educate our citizens so that they can find tech jobs in Connecticut.

There is only one problem with this goal. It assumes that employers will want to locate to Connecticut, a state that only produced a [piddly 1,200 increase](https://substack.com/redirect/1d75346c-ce3a-48c7-bc45-08f4f61fc706?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in jobs in 2025. And to add insult to injury, this small growth was due to increased government and health care jobs. AI, software and manufacturing jobs are not knocking on Connecticut's door.

This Commission cannot solve the real problem. Connecticut is run by Democrats. When you add up the number of government and municipal employees including those with pensions, freeloaders, the sexually avant garde and Trump-hating affluent white liberals, the number exceeds 50%. Thus we are a Deep Blue state.

Everything in sight is taxed, even our cars. Businesses deal with a hostile bureaucracy dedicated to harassing anyone who is profitable. The trial lawyers rule, thus insurance rates for housing, health care, commercial buildings etc. are astronomical. And let's not get started on the climate change fanatics who had the political power to force the state to rely on renewables causing energy costs to rise so high that a public benefits charge had to be surreptitiously added to our bills so that our poorer citizens would not freeze to death. Furthermore, our zoning and environmental laws have resulted in a housing price escalation so that we can't even recruit young doctors to the state.

But the latest kick in the teeth was when Governor Lamont appointed former Education Secretary Miguel Cardona to head this "voluntary" Commission for a fat $250,000 of taxpayer money. And this was a no-bid job!
But according to Kelli-Marie of the State Office of Workforce Strategy, there was not enough time to [solicit other bids](https://substack.com/redirect/00cb9a65-eb5a-45af-980c-86514b54facb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Really? Connecticut has been around for hundreds of years. But it would appear that Ms. Vallieres' workforce strategy is to figure out how political hacks can fleece the taxpayer. Thus, she is worth every penny of her [$209,610 annual salary.](https://substack.com/redirect/8a281f88-1a3b-439c-a296-886989a4cf91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

And let's not forget the ruling of paralegal Melissa Hamilton of Connecticut's Office of State Ethics (an oxymoron if there ever was one) [who stated:](https://substack.com/redirect/d677d1b0-0a3a-4f3b-9e79-0a570c91eb19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Dr. Cardona' s appointment to the Career Pathways Commission ( CPC) does not appear to meet the general definition of " Public official," and even if it did, it appears to satisfy the exception for "Member[ s] of an advisory board," meaning that, one way or the other, Dr. Cardona does not appear to be, as CPC chair, " generally" subject to the Code

In other words, Cardona can keep the money.

You can't make this up! And if you think I am, please click the links. I don't have enough imagination to create such a tale of corruption.

How can Miguel Cardona not be a public official? He was the Secretary of Education! And Office of State Ethics has fourteen full-time employees with an [average salary of $127,319. ](https://substack.com/redirect/8e9cd93a-40d5-4f59-a80c-bac383d844a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Oh well. Even if they can't figure out ethics, some of them must have well-stocked wine cellars.

As for the rest of us sap taxpayers, we will just continue to pay and pay and pay while Governor Lamont can spend infinite amounts of his inherited money (so much for the Democratic scam of money out of politics) and cruise to reelection.
